name: checkout-setup
description: Setting up a quest's checkout brings the realm's main up to date first, makes the checkout from it as the realm says, leaves the realm's repository on main, never cds into the checkout, and records it.
prompt: Set up a code checkout for the add-currency quest.

graders.name: realm-main-pulled
graders.run: test "$(git -C app rev-parse main)" = "$(git -C upstream/app.git rev-parse main)"

graders.name: checkout-from-latest-main
graders.run: git -C worktrees/add-currency merge-base --is-ancestor "$(git -C upstream/app.git rev-parse main)" HEAD

graders.name: recorded
graders.criteria: Current State's workspace entry names the checkout's path (worktrees/add-currency, possibly in full) and its branch.
